scope: Native mid-application boundaries inspected while validating scheduler admission; no cancellation or hook added

content.text:
/* Summary: Dispatches a component tick through native liveness, registration, tick-type and owner
   time-dilation guards.
   
   Parameters:
   pTickFunction: process-local tick-function binding with target component at +0x50.
   flDeltaSeconds: engine interval delta in XMM1.
   nLevelTick: engine level-tick selector in R8D.
   
   Algorithm:
   1. Build a 12-byte local call context: tick-function pointer followed by level-tick selector.
   2. Read target component +0x188 bit 11 as the special level-tick admission flag.
   3. Call 141D2CAC0 with component, flag, delta, selector and address of local context.
   4. Return only after the complete guarded component call.
   
   Returns:
   Void.
   
   Source:
   Native assembly 141D43230..141D43269. Vtable slot +8 at 143865FA0, diagnostic-message slot
   141D41E40 emits [TickComponent]. Vtable 143865F98 is installed by 14237F8F0 and 141D31450.
   
   Replay relevance:
   Helper 141D2CAC0 validates UObject flags 0x30000000, invokes component virtual +0x350, checks
   +0x188 bit 0, resolves owner at +0x190, applies special level-tick rules, and scales delta by
   owner +0x80 or 1.0. It invokes component virtual +0x300 with the original tick-function pointer
   in R9. This includes derived particle fade, completion and destruction work; skipping it is not
   presentation-neutral. Any resumable host continuation must retain logical arguments and validated
   bindings, never this function's stack context.
   
   Special Cases:
   Incoming R9 and stack arguments are not consumed by this concrete implementation. The 12-byte
   local context is valid only for the synchronous helper call. local_28 is the outgoing
   fifth-argument slot, not retained state. Secondary/custom tick-function implementations and
   asynchronous component tasks require separate ownership audit. */

void DispatchComponentTickFunction(void *pTickFunction,float flDeltaSeconds,int nLevelTick)

{
  void *pDispatchTickFunction;
  int nDispatchLevelTick;
  
  pDispatchTickFunction = pTickFunction;
  nDispatchLevelTick = nLevelTick;
  FUN_141d2cac0(*(longlong *)((longlong)pTickFunction + 0x50),
                (byte)(*(uint *)(*(longlong *)((longlong)pTickFunction + 0x50) + 0x188) >> 0xb) & 1,
                flDeltaSeconds,nLevelTick,&pDispatchTickFunction);
  return;
}

observed_limit: Sc6ReplayTaskGroup retains only its verified manager task. Other task payloads synchronously call native virtual+8. Sc6ReplayHost::TrySuspendApplication requires Idle/engine_idle/executor idle and completed tasks. A rejected consumer cannot return as if its native callback completed, nor can arbitrary task/native work be discarded using that manager continuation.
